Le pongo 2 por la atención en playa, no me quisieron dar factura A porque con la app no se podía cosa que no me pasó en  inguna otra ypf, la playera no supo explicarme el porque, lo destacado la amabilidad del sector de comidas que ahí sí pondría 5

I'm giving it 2 stars because of the service at the gas station. They refused to give me an invoice because the app didn't allow it, something that didn't happen at any other YPF station. The attendant couldn't explain why. The highlight was the friendliness of the food staff, for whom I would definitely give it 5 stars.
